Messages.Author: Jesper
Messages.Body:
Hola

Two questions

If Angelo plays a san card, dose he choose what circle he will act like, or dose he just act like all circle? i.e. a superior unwholesome bond, would that put a blood on all blood brothers in the uncontrolled region or only a single circle.

If a vampire changes sect to Blood Brothers it becomes "a circle of one" but what constitutes what /who is in this circle? I.r. play an Hive Mind at superior on a coopy of himself in the uncontrolled region?

/Jesper

The vampire in your uncontrolled region is not a blood brother, so not a legal target.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Jesper wrote:
> Hola
>
> Two questions
>
> If Angelo plays a san card, dose he choose what circle he will act like, or dose he just act like all circle? i.e. a superior unwholesome bond, would that put a blood on all blood brothers in the uncontrolled region or only a single circle.
>
Just one circle.

> Jesper wrote:
> If a vampire changes sect to Blood Brothers it becomes "a circle of one" but what constitutes what /who is in this circle? I.r. play an Hive Mind at superior on a coopy of himself in the uncontrolled region?
>
If the copy is Blood Brother too, the copy is in their own circle of one.
Similarly, if Larry creates Embrace 1 and Embrace 2, Embrace 1 is in "Circle of Embrace 1" and Embrace 2 is in circle "Embrace 2".

Even worse: If Angelo 1 plays sup' Unwholement Bound, and there's Larry and Angelo 2 and Angelo 3 in your uncontrolled region, he gets to play it either as a member of the Chicago cirle, or a member of the Angelo 2 circle or a member of the Angelo 3 circle.
